messages:
anita: Quick heads-up — candidate for Staff Infra (onsite loop) asked to move from Thu 10:00am PT to Thu evening CET. That would overlap with our current panel. Can someone swap into the 10am PT slot if we keep the candidate at the CET time?

samir: @anita I can take 10am PT if needed, but I'm already scheduled for backend interview prep at 11:30am PT — should be fine. Who would free up the evening CET slot?

jordan: I can flip to the evening CET slot if it helps. I won't be able to lead the debrief though. Who's comfortable taking the debrief?

maya_k: I can lead the debrief if @jordan takes the CET slot. Quick rubric Q: Are we using the updated hiring rubric (v2) for Staff? Is scale 1-5 with 3 = minimally acceptable? I want to make sure notes line up with score expectations.

anita: Yes we're on rubric v2 for Staff. Scale is 1-5, and 3 is "meets bar" for this role (we raised the bar vs last cycle). Please call out any strong negatives in the comments — we use that to decide follow-ups.

maya_k: Got it. Also reminder: use the debrief template and paste snippets for code exercise results. Link: https://redwood.company/debriefs/staff-infra (internal)

jordan: SGTM, I'll take CET and @maya_k will lead debrief. Can someone update the calendar and toggle me into the invite?

people-ops-bot: calendar-bot updated attendee list: jordan added to Thu 6:00pm CET slot; samir added to Thu 10:00am PT slot.

anita: Thanks all — small checklist before interview: (1) confirm debrief doc pre-filled with prompts, (2) ensure candidate materials open in interview room link, (3) remind interviewers to submit scores within 24h.

maya_k: Copy. I'll pre-fill the debrief with the code prompts and rubric rows.

jordan: One more quick question on scoring: for "system design" do we weigh it equal to "execution" for Staff infra? Or is system design heavier?

anita: For Staff infra we weigh system design ~1.2x execution; note that in the debrief doc I added the weight column. If you disagree on weight, flag it in the comments but score normally during the call.

maya_k: Nice, thanks. Ping if anything breaks with invites.

samir: I updated my calendar — ping me if you need me to take any follow-up interviews same week. :thumbsup:

interview-bot: Reminder: debrief forms are due within 24 hours of the interview. If not submitted, the candidate will be stalled in pipeline.

anita: Awesome — closing loop. @jordan I'll DM you the code exercise scoring notes before the interview. :wave:
